messages:
viv-liu: Posting a concise battlecard update we should iterate on today — focus: serving economics + graceful fallbacks vs cloud AI providers and infra vendors. Need quick thumbs on bench language, one-liner elevator, and webinar/demo angle.

priya-k: Thanks. Uploaded draft here: https://redwood.internal/marketing/battlecards/serving-econ-vs-cloud-draft (pls comment). Suggested priorities: 1) quantify unit cost wins, 2) be explicit about rollback/fallback flow, 3) include an AE-ready objection play.

sam-g: Sales asks for a clear latency soundbite we can use in calls. Can Jon give a p99 for 2k-token conv prompts and a short note about dataset? If it's verifiable we can use: "~3x lower p99 than VendorX on long-form convs".

jon-eng: Pasting quick bench snippet and methodology note. Ran on similar model config, no retokenization, mixed workload of conv prompts + generation.

jon-eng: ```
workload      | seq=512 p50 | seq=512 p99 | seq=2048 p50 | seq=2048 p99
Redwood-prod  | 38ms        | 195ms       | 165ms        | 750ms
VendorX-std   | 62ms        | 610ms       | 260ms        | 2400ms
notes: p99 measured across 30k requests, warm cache, batching enabled.
```

casey-sales: Perfect. Two asks: 1) Add a 1-line procurement play: "Managed serving + rollout + compliance beats DIY GPUs for teams that need SLAs and telemetry." 2) Routing: tag inbound leads who mention "on-prem", "SLA", or "dedicated" so AE triggers enterprise playbook.

ashley-ops: Ops note: webinar slot tentatively Wed 10am PT. I'll lock calendar once we confirm speakers. Also recommend a short checklist for the live demo (simulate region failover, show fallback, surface cost delta slide).

priya-k: Draft elevator for copy: "Redwood Inference: serving-first LLM inference that keeps apps online, predictable in cost, and observable at token level." Thoughts?

sam-g: Love it. Webinar hook idea: "10 minutes, two demos: steady-state economics + chaos failover that keeps the user experience intact." Keep it tactical, not vendor-bashy.

jon-eng: Small addition to the doc: include a reproducibility snippet so field engineers can reproduce the bench: 

jon-eng: ```bash
# synthetic run for p99 snapshot
python bench/run.py --model redwood-opt --seq 2048 --batch 8 --requests 30000 --seed 42
```

casey-sales: I'll draft the procurement/objection play and a quick TCO delta slide using Jon's numbers. Will add routing tags for SDR flows: inbound_flag=[enterprise_onprem, sla_request, dedicated_capacity].

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar registration deadline Tue 5pm PT. :calendar:

viv-liu: Great thread. Next steps: Priya updates battlecard copy + elevator; Jon adds bench reproducibility + brief methodology paragraph; Casey prepares procurement slide & inbound tag set; Sam drafts 10-min webinar runbook. Aim to publish the updated battlecard + slide pack Thu EOD. Thanks team! :rocket:
